Adcock Ingram is a privately held company co-owned by the **Bidvest Group** (retaining majority control) and Indian generic drugmaker **Natco Pharma**, which holds a 49% stake following a buyout of minority shares and subsequent delisting from the Johannesburg Stock Exchange. [](https://pharma.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/mergers-and-acquisitions/natco-pharma-to-acquire-significant-stakes-in-s-african-firm-adcock-ingram/124498772)

- **Bidvest Group:** Holds the majority share.

- **Natco Pharma:** Owns a 49% stake through its subsidiary. [](https://www.thehindu.com/business/natco-pharma-raises-stake-in-south-africas-adcock-ingram-to-49/article71220958.ece)

### Company Background

- **Delisting:** Privatized and delisted from the JSE following a R4.2 billion buyout deal.

- **Leadership:** Headed by CEO Rhulani Nhlaniki. [](https://pharma.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/mergers-and-acquisitions/natco-pharma-to-acquire-significant-stakes-in-s-african-firm-adcock-ingram/124498772)
